summary: The gate evidence guide now says what to do when a merge-group run fails a signed check. File the failure with an owner and fix its cause first. Then the pull requests still refused on those inputs can be lifted by re-signing, or by one rerun of all of that run's jobs, which the observer records as newer passes.

rules.detail: Documentation only. The rule that a newer failure with the same input key decides is unchanged.

manual.detail: Operators treat a merge-group failure in a signed check as a defect: file it, fix its cause or record the owner's disposition, then re-sign the affected pull requests or rerun all jobs of that run once. A rerun of only the failed job has no source artifact for its attempt and is never observed, and a push to main is not observed at all.
